assessments.finding: The inspected D4RT v1 method decodes point-level 4D queries and uses Gaussian blur as training augmentation, not Gaussian splat scene primitives. No concrete GS dependency is established by the inspected primary sources. This is not a claim of global downstream absence.

The inspected primary method and reported experiments use a NeRF backbone. Its Extension to Gaussian Splatting discussion describes a possible representation change, not an implemented or evaluated GS pipeline. GS references and that proposal alone do not resolve the current curated-foundation scope review.
SplatFlux uses DA3 initialization in the inspected method. VGGT-Ω appears among references; this source was not adopted as evidence of a direct VGGT-Ω or D4RT dependency.
